Open-Source Software communities require predictable, annual financial support. Partners and Supporters ensure that everyone in the community has access to expert advice, predictable releases, testing, documentation, and consistent guidance and governance. **Your investment in becoming a Samvera Partner or Supporter is used for shared staffing hours and community tools to reduce the workload of your local staff.** ## How to Support the Samvera Community [Become a Samvera Partner](#become-a-partner) [Become a Samvera Supporter](#become-a-samvera-supporter) [Contribute to Community Co-Investment Funds](#community-co-investment-funds) [Support Samvera via your existing Consortium Membership](#Support-Samvera-via-your-existing-Consortial-Membership) [Special Partnership Benefits for Service Provider & Consortia Partners](#Special-Partnership-Offerings-for-Service-Provider-Consortial-Partners) [New Samvera Partner benefit: the Hyrax and Hyku Upgrade Planning Service](#new-samvera-partner-benefit-the-hyrax-and-hyku-upgrade-planning-service) ## Become a Partner: Partners are the heart of the Samvera Community. Partnership gives you access to participation in Samvera governance and the ability to help shape community strategy. You also receive special benefits as a Partner, including: * [Annual Custom Upgrade Planning Service](#New-Samvera-Partner-benefit-the-Hyrax-and-Hyku-Upgrade-Planning-Service) * Organization-wide discounts on paid event fees * Invitation to monthly Partner call to advise the Samvera Board * Eligibility to serve on the Samvera Board * Voting rights in annual Samvera Board elections Partnership has annual contribution dues based on institution or organization size ($525 / $1,050 / $5,250 / $7,825 / $10,500). To become a Partner fill out the [Partnership Request Form](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdi20pC9C9gBjHyf2lqQlYVJ4qyTUWNXxNiEQI3Qnt-MyD5xg/viewform?usp=header) or learn more on the [Partnership Dues page on the Samvera Wiki](https://samvera.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/samvera/pages/1872461833/About+Samvera+Partners). ### Become a Sustaining Partner Sustaining Partners provide $14,000 or more annual sustaining contributions. Sustaining Partners recieve special recognition at virtual and in person conferences. To become a Sustaining Partner fill out the [Partnership Request Form](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdi20pC9C9gBjHyf2lqQlYVJ4qyTUWNXxNiEQI3Qnt-MyD5xg/viewform?usp=header) or learn more on the [Partnership Dues page on the Samvera Wiki](https://samvera.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/samvera/pages/1872461833/About+Samvera+Partners). ## Become a Samvera Supporter Partnership is a low annual cost for very small and small institutions and organizations. If Partnership is not an option for your larger institution or organization, you can become a Samvera Supporter. Samvera Supporters are doing their part to support the community they rely on, and receive additional benefits: * Discounted hourly rate for technical consulting services * Recognition on the Samvera website and in the annual report Supporters provide a minimum $2,500+ annual sustaining contribution. Supporters located in World Bank-classified low- or lower-middle-income economies may contribute $1,250 (50% reduction) to reflect appropriate market rates. Become a Samvera Supporter by completing the [Supporter request form](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfYiWJJm7hP3SNzscXmsJDeQUtdqBPXJvc4Q3KtFXnLPHPr_A/viewform?usp=header). ### Partnership And Supporter Benefits Review

## Special Partnership Offerings for Service Provider & Consortial Partners **Service Provider Partner:** for commercial and nonprofit service providers and consortia who want to show their commitment to the community. Annual contribution is based on total billable hours. All of the above listed Partnership benefits, plus: * Service Provider Partner logo use * Priority listing on [Samvera.org](Samvera.org) service provider page * Option to receive requests for demos and RFPs submitted to the community or collected from the Hyku website Email heather@samvera.org to learn more or become a Partner. ### Support Samvera via your existing Consortial Membership If you use Hyku or other Samvera Community software as a member of a consortium, and you would prefer to support Samvera via contributions to your consortium, you can contribute to your consortium’s Samvera Partnership Fund. Talk to your provider consortium representative or email heather@samvera.org for more information. ## Community Co-Investment Funds These are additional, optional funds designated for community-led co-investment in community-designated development priorities. * **Hyku Community Development Co-Investment Fund - **co-invest in feature development for roadmap priorities selected and led by the Hyku Interest Group. * **Hyrax/Hyku Maintenance Co-Investment Fund** - Co-invest in critical maintenance by contributing to the Maintenance Co-Investment Fund. Co-investment dollars are used to fund maintenance work including accessibility improvements, component upgrades, and other critical work that is required to keep Samvera software up-to-date. Email heather@samvera.org to contribute to these funds. ## New Samvera Partner benefit: the Hyrax and Hyku Upgrade Planning Service **As institutional budgets face scrutiny, the Samvera Community is looking for ways to directly connect how financial support that sustains the community also returns concrete support to each Partner institution.** Institutions have told us that upgrading to the latest versions of Hyrax and Hyku is an activity where subject expertise could provide efficiency and confidence in the planning stages. **Samvera Partnership now includes dedicated technical planning support.** Each year, every Partner institution can elect to receive one detailed upgrade plan for a selected Hyrax or Hyku application. This is a focused assessment with a sequenced roadmap for planning, budgeting, and beginning the upgrade process. The plan is created by Rob Kaufman in his community-funded role as Hyrax and Hyku Technical Coordinator. Ohio State University Libraries participated as a pilot for the upgrade plan process. You can [read their case study](https://samvera.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/samvera/pages/4423745555) to learn about their experience: “We feel more confident moving forward in this endeavor. The upgrade and migration service is a wonderful support to Samvera Partners, and we highly encourage others to take advantage of it. Rob’s analysis is worth every penny of our Partner dues.” All the details, including an example report table of contents and answers to some frequently asked questions, can be found on the [Hyrax and Hyku Upgrade Planning Service page on the Samvera Community wiki](https://samvera.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/samvera/pages/4423450635/Samvera+Partner+Benefit+Hyrax+and+Hyku+Upgrade+Planning+Service).

openGraphData.og:description: Samvera™ is a vibrant and welcoming community of information and technology professionals who share challenges, build expertise, and create sustainable, best-in-class solutions, making the world’s digital collections accessible now and into the future. Samvera’s suite of repository software tools offers flexible and rich user interfaces tailored to distinct content types on top of a robust back end – giving adopters the best of both worlds.
